name: GAN 11 Pro 3x3 (Magnetic, Core Magnets)
description: The GAN 11 Pro 3x3 (Magnetic, Core Magnets) is GAN Cube’s 2020 flagship speed cube, and it has remained a top choice among competitive speedcubers since its release. This magnetic 3x3 cube features a core magnet system for improved stability, enhanced corner-cutting, and a more connected feel, delivering one of the smoothest and fastest solving experiences available in the world of speedcubing.
features: Dual-adjustment core for independent spring compression & tension
Corner-to-core magnets for a better, more controllable turning feel
